event: UK NARIC study for IBO: DP alignment with Norwegian upper secondary education

event: Covid-2020 IB algorithm grades revised; NRKbeta 'Flere IB-elever får bedre karakterer'
HK-dir publishes new IB conversion table to apply from 2025/26 admission; based on global IBO statistics, Norsk Regnesentral method, starts at 24 points
note: Also familieportalen.mfa.no/?p=912; 24 IB points -> grade 2 in all subjects (Dok 8:76 S)

event: NIBS letter to parents/guardians/alumni: table unfair, devalues IB, no consultation, sampling bias; letters also to HK-dir, ministry, Storting committee; IBO Director General letter to HK-dir
Ministry hearing on admission regulation 2025-2026 including HK-dir's IB table; Abelia submits response
Written question Dok 15:2 (2024-2025) from Kari-Anne Jønnes (H): does the table reflect IB students' knowledge level? HK-dir ignored national data
Hoel answer: table announced 2022, effective 2025-26, based on official IB statistics; current table unchanged since 1990s
Written question Dok 15:571 (2024-2025) from Abid Raja (V) on new IB conversion model
Hoel answer: ~100 tables, same NR statistical method, Sweden and Denmark similar; SO authority since 2010 excluded IB
Dok 8:76 S (2024-2025): Jønnes (H), Gulati (FrP), Wold (SV), Raja (V), Ropstad (KrF) ask Storting to postpone IB table changes until affected parties are involved
Dok 8:76 S listed (item 166) and referred to utdannings- og forskningskomiteen
Minister Sigrun Aasland (Ap) postpones the table one year (to 2026 admission) and sends it on hearing; ANSA welcomes
Samordna opptak withdraws table; not used in 2025 either; new hearing to follow
Hearing on new IB table (same statistical method) proposed from 2026/27 admission; many objections; ministry drops it

event: Legeforeningen hearing response on new admission regulation (gender cap, admission test); IB not addressed in snippets

NIBS and Abelia meet Kunnskapsdepartementet; NIBS to be invited into HK-dir process; agreement that all pupils should be treated fairly
